operations.name: instrument.search
operations.implementation_scope: Opt-in synthetic historical reads through the shared Rust registry; no external source or live subscription.

operations.name: market.getBars
operations.implementation_scope: Opt-in synthetic historical reads through the shared Rust registry; no external source or live subscription.

operations.name: chart.setTimeframe
operations.implementation_scope: The private protocol 1.1 workspace registry updates the registered main chart. New writes check both revision tokens. A scoped on-device AI intent with selected CSV evidence requires access to that interval. Replay returns the persisted chart-only receipt under current workspace disclosure.

operations.name: indicator.createDraft
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 profile-local human dispatch stages a typed declarative draft or the exact bytes of explicitly selected trusted Python.

operations.name: indicator.runPreview
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 profile-local human dispatch freezes an authorized published CSV or bound offline sample interval. The sample uses its exact verified adapter schedule. The registry validates declarative output and exposes correlated bounded preview status. An explicitly selected trusted Python draft on the bound synthetic source requires a separate local human decision for each exact code, parameter and frozen input tuple. The interpreter runs with the local user’s permissions and its result is independently validated.

operations.name: indicator.acceptVersion
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 profile-local human confirmation commits one exact entitled CSV preview or approved synthetic Python preview, immutable validated output, and a replayable undo receipt under current source rights.

operations.name: indicator.remove
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 profile-local human dispatch detaches an accepted chart layer with a repeatable receipt and a revision-bound inverse. The immutable version remains retained.

operations.name: workspace.previewLayout
operations.implementation_scope: The profile-scoped workspace registry previews built-in panel edits at the current revision.

operations.name: workspace.applyLayout
operations.implementation_scope: The profile-scoped workspace registry applies a matching preview with a durable replayable undo receipt.

operations.name: workspace.undo
operations.implementation_scope: The private protocol 1.1 workspace registry reverses an eligible main-chart timeframe or applied layout operation in the initiating actor, principal and client scope. Current revisions and the recorded after-state are checked. A committed inverse has its own replayable receipt.

operations.name: task.cancel
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 profile-local human dispatch cancels an unpublished declarative indicator preview.

operations.name: market.readHistoryPage
operations.implementation_scope: Protocol 1.1 opt-in synthetic reads, exact frozen input replay, quality reporting and byte-bounded pages. Explicit stream handoff returns a position when the snapshot includes the replay bar.

operations.name: market.subscribe
operations.implementation_scope: Explicit, finite synthetic chart replay through the shared Rust registry. Local development transports only.

operations.name: market.previewLocalImport
operations.implementation_scope: Local human preview of a CSV in the current trusted folder selection through the desktop development worker. Raw records, diagnostics and eligible normalized bars bind to the read file digest. Publication and refresh are separate work.

operations.name: market.saveLocalImportMapping
operations.implementation_scope: Explicit local human save of a reviewed CSV mapping and its source header association through the profile-bound Rust SQLite writer.

operations.name: market.loadLocalImportMapping
operations.implementation_scope: Local human retrieval of a reviewed CSV mapping for the authorized source in the active profile, with review required when its header changes.

operations.name: market.publishLocalImport
operations.implementation_scope: A local human explicitly publishes one complete reviewed native CSV series. The Rust registry binds the current selected file, complete source checksum and saved mapping; the authenticated profile writer retains the original bytes and immutable source row provenance.

operations.name: market.listLocalImportRevisions
operations.implementation_scope: Return a bounded summary page of displayable frozen CSV revisions for the active local human profile. Ascending revision IDs provide a stable exclusive cursor. A caller can opt in to the frozen venue, the first and final bars' trading days, and the final bar's close. The default reply retains its original fields. Listing needs no source directory, returns no source grant or raw content and does not replace read-time authorization.

operations.name: market.readLocalImportRevision
operations.implementation_scope: Return immutable bars and source row provenance by revision ID in the entitled local human profile. This read requires no directory access and neither refreshes the revision nor grants other data access.

operations.name: market.readLocalImportSourceRow
operations.implementation_scope: A local human reads one source record for a displayable single-file frozen CSV revision in the active profile. Resolve the exact published locator and parse the retained bytes using the revision's reviewed encoding and delimiter. Return the source digest, locator, and aligned headers and original field values in source order. The successful result is limited to 64 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. This read uses profile storage and remains available after source removal.

operations.name: market.previewLocalFolderRefresh
operations.implementation_scope: A trusted local human previews the current authorized directory against an entitled frozen single-file or folder revision from that directory. Reuse its saved mapping for compatible complete native bars. Retain all attributable locators for equal bars and surface competing values, replaced files and withdrawal candidates for review. Staging has no publication effect.

operations.name: market.prepareLocalFolderPublication
operations.implementation_scope: Build the canonical candidate for one live reviewed preview after the local human chooses every competing bar and acknowledges every withdrawn path and bar. Return the candidate fingerprint and counts.

operations.name: market.publishLocalFolderRefresh
operations.implementation_scope: An explicit local human action publishes the prepared candidate in one guarded profile transaction. Revalidate current complete files and the selected root. Within the same profile, workspace and root association, an entitled replay matches the idempotency key and canonical candidate digest and returns the committed revision without rereading source content. The renewed local folder grant and the transport request or preview identifiers do not define the durable receipt.

operations.name: market.listLocalFolderRevisions
operations.implementation_scope: List entitled immutable folder revisions in stable revision ID order within the local human profile. Listing needs no directory grant.

operations.name: market.readLocalFolderRevision
operations.implementation_scope: Open an entitled frozen folder revision, chosen bars and source-qualified row locators without reopening the directory. A summary-only request omits file and bar details.

operations.name: market.readLocalFolderSourceRow
operations.implementation_scope: Read one original CSV record through a displayable frozen folder revision in the active local human profile. Require the exact chosen source path, content digest and record locator in that manifest. Parse retained bytes with the historical reviewed mapping and return aligned headers and original field values. The result is limited to 64 KiB of UTF-8 JSON and remains available after source removal.

operations.name: market.revokeLocalFolderRevision
operations.implementation_scope: An explicit local human action removes display rights for a folder revision. Its stored data and separately entitled lineage remain in the profile.

operations.name: market.revokeLocalImportRevision
operations.implementation_scope: An explicit local human action withdraws the active profile's right to display this immutable revision. Repeat requests return the same revision ID. The original and provenance remain in the profile.

operations.name: workspace.readChartProjection
operations.implementation_scope: Read only authorized fields and opaque revision references from the current published CSV or bundled sample selection. Local CSV display is profile-bound. Trusted on-device analysis keeps its separate grant. The activated Ollama chart route admits only the verified bundled sample closes and timestamps to its named recipient.

operations.name: workspace.selectEvidence
operations.implementation_scope: Select or clear a verified chart interval. Published local CSV selection remains profile-local and durable. A bundled sample selection binds the current verified snapshot and range in memory with the same durable selection token. A trusted on-device analysis intent carries its separate grant. Workspace object, table row and document passage targets are pending.

operations.name: ai.textConnection
operations.implementation_scope: Profile-bound local human route settings and current-session turns. A one-use recipient disclosure precedes activation. Opt-in Ollama chart turns can negotiate a single read of the selected bundled sample times and closes through the AI actor and shared workspace registry. Other tools, private records and mutations remain outside the route grant.

implemented_wire_behaviors: The opt-in market worker supports instrument.search and market.getBars for compatible legacy callers. Negotiated 1.1 adds market.readHistoryPage and finite market.subscribe replay. The generic market worker launched without the sample advertises no market operations.
The dedicated local import worker accepts bounded NDJSON frames containing Rust-read CSV bytes and the selected mapping. The shared local preview operation runs through the application registry.

Trusted local users can publish a complete native CSV as an immutable profile-local revision, read its bars and source row locators, and remove its display permission through the application registry. Publication uses the profile-bound Rust SQLite writer.
clarifications: Workspace revisions are non-negative safe integers; dataset revisions are opaque provider-owned strings.
Operation outputs are objects. instrument.search wraps its array in instruments.
Worker hello is unsolicited; the host validates the negotiated version, required capabilities and expected role before sending work.
Cancel references request_id; heartbeat has only common envelope fields.
Schema definitions are canonical. Small per-operation schemas and all language types are generated from them.
Metadata, params, provenance and error details are explicit data bags; they never confer authority.
Schema validation is structural. Cross-field market invariants, AST budgets, role authorization and response correlation require application validation.
Specifying a payload does not expose or implement that operation. Unsupported operations fail closed.
Decision-note commands and operation-specific replies use the private local workspace transport. The core checks current profile access and issues short-lived confirmations for writes.
first_product_scenario: View the current chart, ask AI for analysis and an indicator, preview it, then explicitly accept an immutable version.
development_data: Explicit synthetic demo and development samples. The native CSV picker grants session-only directory access, while frozen revisions remain available under profile rights. Saved local sources and Parquet are current requirements awaiting implementation.
service_capabilities: The current contract requires M1-030 to deliver Settings > Data sources > My data sources on a fresh install. Users can select a folder containing market files they downloaded or configure their own API endpoint and credential fields. They can test, save, refresh and disconnect their sources without a ScopeHub account or plan. Verify the API setup and lifecycle with a controlled connector. Only the selected connector uses locally stored provider credentials. Optional ScopeHub data services are labeled and selected separately. Live external market-data provider delivery and qualification remain later (M1-009). Internal model adapters, external AI clients and eligible ScopeHub services are independently selected and authorized. Production services and client access are unconfigured.
